video_title: Olivia Miles On Becoming A WNBA All-Star As A Rookie & Representing Team USA

quotes.speaker: Olivia Miles
quotes.summary_phrase: Olivia Miles on the intensity of the WNBA All-Star experience
quotes.excerpt: It's so hard to enjoy because it's like you need to be at 50 places all at once

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: How did Olivia feel about herself in the moment right then?

text_blocks.speaker: Olivia Miles
text_blocks.text: Everything was happening so fast. They were like, okay, you got to go here, you got to go there. It's so hard to enjoy because it's like you need to be at 50 places all at once. So, I had my 10 seconds where they were like, Olivia Miles or whatever, and I came and I don't even know what I did. I think I waved.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy McGrady on Olivia Miles setting the tone for WNBA All-Star games
quotes.excerpt: You set the tone of what the WNBA All-Star game will look like every year

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: Wembanyama made it clear, he was going out there to play. If you didn't want to play, that's fine. But you set the tone of what the WNBA All-Star game will look like every year that you're in the game. Everybody will know, it's great to be in here, but once it's time to play, Olivia Miles is about to come out here and get busy.

text_blocks.speaker: Olivia Miles
text_blocks.text: Hoopers know that when the ball gets thrown up, it's just hoop at the end of the day.

quotes.speaker: Olivia Miles
quotes.summary_phrase: Olivia Miles on the increased visibility and fan recognition in the WNBA
quotes.excerpt: I still can't go to local shops or something without someone coming up to me
quotes.quote: I thought people knew me, and still, I'm not as popular as Paige, Caitlin, and all them in Asia, but this is crazy. I can't go to local shops or something without someone coming up to me, or I see people wearing my jersey randomly on the road. It's crazy. I'm not LeBron James, and I understand that, but I still can't go to local shops or something without someone coming up to me.

quotes.speaker: Olivia Miles
quotes.summary_phrase: Olivia Miles on the importance of staying grounded and winning championships
quotes.excerpt: The main thing is winning a championship
quotes.quote: From a young age, I had to mature quickly because I was always playing with older girls. As a point guard, you have to command, you have to be confident in what you're doing. I've always been a competitor at heart, and I know awards will follow if my team is doing well. I never really worry about that stuff. It's nice to be in those conversations and to have the opportunity to do it, but that's not the main thing. The main thing is winning a championship.

quotes.speaker: Olivia Miles
quotes.summary_phrase: Olivia Miles on the surreal feeling of winning gold medals with Team USA
quotes.excerpt: I've won two gold medals with the USA and that feeling of winning a gold medal is surreal
quotes.quote: I've won two gold medals with the USA and that feeling of winning a gold medal is surreal. I don't even know what it feels like to win a World Cup or an Olympics. We won an AmeriCup and I felt on top of the world holding both medals. I love USA basketball because you go into a system where you acknowledge that you are not the one, you are together for a bigger purpose and a bigger goal. We saw a few years back with the men's USA, Jason Tatum didn't really play, and he just won a championship in the NBA Finals. You just understand that it's just bigger than you.
